newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey's Yilmaz in coalition strategy meeting.
newsitem.headline: Turkey's Yilmaz in coalition strategy meeting.

text.p: Turkey's prime minister-designate Mesut Yilmaz was to hold a meeting of his conservative Motherland Party on Monday to plan strategy for his bid to forge an anti-Islamist coalition.
Party officials said the meeting was to begin at 0800 GMT.
The Turkish press said Yilmaz and his aides would discuss ways to woo fellow conservatives from Deputy Prime Minister Tansu Ciller's True Path Party into the planned secularist alliance.
Istanbul shares were up 3.9 percent in the first minutes of trading on Monday on hopes that Yilmaz would form a coalition, brokers said.

A dissident MP from Ciller's faction who resigned on Sunday was expected to join Motherland on Monday. Yilmaz is around a dozen votes short of the simple majority he would need to win a confidence vote in a government he set up.
President Suleyman Demirel last week nominated Yilmaz to put together a government after the resignation of Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan, who stays on as caretaker for the time being.
Erbakan, modern Turkey's first Islamist leader, stepped down after months of open criticism from the secularist army.
